## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and the scope of this change. Link a related
issue when applicable.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. For UI/input changes, identify
the APK variant, Android version and device or emulator, and attach relevant
screenshots. Mark anything not tested explicitly.

## Data and compatibility

Explain any effect on existing games, saves, profiles, library data, package
IDs or external launchers. Write "not affected" for documentation-only changes.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I kept unrelated changes and generated files out of this PR.
- [ ] I included no signing keys, personal data or game files without documented permissions.
- [ ] I described remaining risks or untested behavior.

GitHub Actions is intentionally disabled; no automated CI pass is required.
